clue.text: Criterion which judges observe

parts.note: the bench is the collective term for judges or magistrates
to mark is to notice or observe

explanation.surface: A standard that the judiciary keeps to.
explanation.definitionFit: A benchmark is a standard against which other things are measured, so a criterion.

clue.text: School where oriental gains score of one hundred

parts.note: E stands for east, so oriental
a ton is a score of a hundred, as in cricket or darts

explanation.surface: A pupil from the Far East achieves a perfect hundred at an academy.
explanation.walkthrough: ETON is the famous English public school near Windsor.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton College is an example of a school, the best-known English private boarding one.

clue.text: To live together is a firm, established practice

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a habit is a settled custom or practice

explanation.surface: Sharing a home is described as a long-standing custom.
explanation.definitionFit: Couples who cohabit share a household without being married.

clue.text: Mother, on being milked of cash, was incoherent

parts.note: mum is an informal word for mother
to be bled is to have money extorted, drained dry

explanation.surface: A mother, fleeced of all her money, can only babble.
explanation.definitionFit: To mumble is to speak indistinctly, so someone who mumbled was hard to understand.

clue.text: To classify in hierarchical order is offensive

definitions.meaning: to arrange things by grade or position

explanation.surface: Sorting people into tiers is described as distasteful.
explanation.definitionFit: Rank is both a verb for grading in order and an adjective for rotten or grossly offensive.

clue.text: Drug pusher who enjoys life in the fast lane

definitions.text: who enjoys life in the fast lane

parts.note: speed is slang for amphetamine
a merchant is a dealer or seller, here one who pushes goods

explanation.surface: A drug dealer who lives recklessly and fast.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as 'one who' loves velocity; the wordplay gives a seller of amphetamine.
explanation.definitionFit: A speed merchant is slang for someone who loves driving or moving very fast.

clue.text: Handling of astronomical subjects requires special attention

parts.note: stars are what astronomers study
treatment is the handling or dealing with something

explanation.surface: Dealing with heavenly bodies demands extra care.
explanation.definitionFit: Star treatment is lavish favoured handling, the kind given to a celebrity.

clue.text: Capable of taking note of meeting with it

parts.note: if you are up to a task you are capable of it
the minutes are the written record of a meeting; one entry is a minute

explanation.surface: Someone able to take the minutes at a meeting, as a job requirement.
explanation.definitionFit: Being with it means being fashionable and current, fully modern.

clue.text: Only a half-wit would obstruct the boss

parts.note: to block is to obstruct
the head is the person in charge

explanation.surface: Only a fool would stand in the way of their manager.
explanation.definitionFit: A blockhead is a stupid person, a dunce or fool.

clue.text: Woman's 'usband in confined accommodation is constant

indicators.note: in places the woman's husband inside the confined lodging

parts.note: pent means penned or shut up, confined
her man with the H dropped, as the apostrophe in 'usband signals, gives 'er man

explanation.surface: A Cockney wife says her husband, stuck in cramped digs, never changes.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped H of ''usband' tells you to drop it from 'her' too, giving 'ER MAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Permanent means lasting or unchanging, so constant.

clue.text: Schubert song gave a false impression

definitions.meaning: a German art song of the kind Schubert wrote hundreds of

explanation.surface: A Schubert song is said to have misled listeners.
explanation.definitionFit: Lied is the German word for an art song; lied is also the past tense of lie, to deceive.

clue.text: Daggers drawn when alumnus confronts Hebrew high priest

parts.note: OB stands for old boy, a former pupil
Eli was the high priest in the Book of Samuel

explanation.surface: A former pupil faces an ancient priest in a bitter quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Daggers drawn' suggests hostility; an obelus is the dagger-shaped printer's mark.
explanation.definitionFit: An obelus is the printer's dagger symbol used for footnotes; obeli is its plural.

clue.text: Independent sovereign is in charge

indicators.note: is in tells us that the sovereign sits inside the charge

parts.note: a fee is a charge or payment
R stands for rex or regina, king or queen

explanation.surface: A self-governing monarch holds the reins.
explanation.definitionFit: To be free is to be autonomous, not under another's control.

clue.text: Saw unknown man coming in badly hurt

indicators.note: coming in shows the stranger entering the injury word

parts.note: to maim is to injure badly
X stands for an unknown, as in Mr X, the unnamed man

explanation.surface: A stranger arrived seriously injured and someone saw him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the past of see; here it is the noun, an old saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is a traditional proverb or saying, the same as an adage.

clue.text: Opportunity to get small ceremonial vestment

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a cope is a long cloak worn by clergy at ceremonies

explanation.surface: A chance to obtain a modest robe for a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Scope means room or freedom to act, so an opportunity.

clue.text: Brief agreement

definitions.meaning: a treaty or pact between parties

explanation.surface: A short legal contract.
explanation.definitionFit: Compact is an adjective for concise and a noun for a formal pact.

clue.text: Form of art with spirit and propriety

parts.note: Art Deco is a decorative design style of the 1920s and 30s
rum is a spirit distilled from sugar cane

explanation.surface: A style of art paired with liquor and good manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorum is behaviour in keeping with good taste, seemliness.

clue.text: Great fortitude needed if lady-love is married

parts.note: Hero was the beloved of Leander in Greek myth

explanation.surface: A man needs courage if his sweetheart already has a husband.
explanation.walkthrough: Hero, a priestess, was loved by Leander, who swam the Hellespont nightly to see her.
explanation.definitionFit: Heroism is great bravery, courage under severe trial.

clue.text: Order partner to come around as well

indicators.note: the partner word comes around the other, enclosing it

parts.note: a mate is a partner or companion
and means as well, in addition

explanation.surface: Tell your partner to visit as well.
explanation.definitionFit: A mandate is an official command or instruction.

clue.text: To clarify matters is no longer simple

parts.note: ex means former, no longer so
plain means simple or unadorned

explanation.surface: Explaining things has stopped being straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: To explain is to make something clear and understandable.

clue.text: Eurocurrency Dora changed in South America

parts.note: the ecu was the European currency unit before the euro

indicators.note: changed means the letters of the name are rearranged

explanation.surface: Dora swapped her European money while in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecuador is a country located on the Pacific coast of South America.

clue.text: A pain in the trachea

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the word trachea

explanation.surface: Discomfort in the windpipe.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a dull continuous pain.

clue.text: Finish with one's tail in the air

parts.note: the end is the tail or rear of something
up means aloft, in the air

explanation.surface: A dog or a duck finishes with its rear raised.
explanation.definitionFit: To end up is to finish or arrive somewhere eventually.

clue.text: An Egyptian god has the last word

definitions.meaning: a Theban deity of ancient Egypt, also spelt Amun or Amon
said at the close of a prayer

explanation.surface: An Egyptian deity gets to conclude the argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Amen is a variant name of the god Amun, and the word ending a prayer.

clue.text: Native Americans about to enter Anglican church

indicators.note: to enter puts the word for about inside the church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Indigenous people are about to go into an English church.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cree are an indigenous people of Canada and the northern US.

clue.text: Stomach is upset by cereal fungus

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the words upside down, so they read backwards

parts.note: tum is informal for stomach
is shortened to an apostrophe-s

explanation.surface: Someone has indigestion from a mouldy grain.
explanation.definitionFit: Smut is a fungal disease of cereal crops that blackens the grain.

clue.text: An admired gent, unusually popular

indicators.note: unusually means these letters are arranged differently

explanation.surface: A gentleman who is admired is remarkably sought after.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in great demand is wanted by many people, that is, popular.

clue.text: Notable bishop is in haste

indicators.note: is in shows the bishop sits inside the word for speed

parts.note: celerity means swiftness or haste
B is the chess notation abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A distinguished cleric is in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrity is a famous person, someone of note.
